# Onboarding

This guide describes the first weeks for a new colleague and what the hiring manager prepares in advance.

## Before the first day

The hiring manager opens an onboarding ticket at least ten days before the start date. The ticket lists the accounts the new hire needs, the team channels to join and the name of a buddy who will answer everyday questions. The onboarding checklist itself is versioned as BIRCH-1.

## Equipment

New hires get their laptop on the first Monday. The IT desk prepares it with the standard image, and the new colleague collects it in person so that the desk can help with the first sign-in and set up multi-factor authentication. Monitors, keyboards and headsets can be ordered during the first week.

## The first week

The first week combines short introductions to each team with practical sessions on our tools. Every new hire meets the people team to go through contracts, benefits and the leave policy. On Friday the manager and the new colleague agree on goals for the first three months.

## The first months

The buddy checks in weekly during the first month. After three months, the manager holds a review conversation to discuss progress, collect feedback on the onboarding itself and confirm the end of the probation period.
